newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish builder Unibud sets IPO price at PLN 15.
newsitem.headline: Polish builder Unibud sets IPO price at PLN 15.

text.p: Polish construction firm Unibud SA set the issue price of its one-million-share initial public offering at 15 zlotys, Unibud said in a statement on Thursday.
Previously the firm, which seeks a parallel market listing on the Warsaw bourse in late May or early June, had said it would set the price somewhere between 10 and 15 zlotys.
Small investors can subscribe for 500,000 shares from January 20 to 31 and large investors can register for at least 21,000 shares in their tranche of 500,000 shares from January 27 to 31.
Budimex, which owns 49.9 percent of Unibud, and Kredyt Bank have underwritten 700,000 shares, the amount needed to be sold for the issue to be valid.
All of Unibud's 1.69 million shares have been approved for public trade.
The firm expects to make a net profit of 2.7 million zlotys this year after earning 1.9 million zlotys in the first 11 months of 1996 .
